404 Not Found error when requesting a model that does not exist

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest
from liter_llm import LiterLlmError, NotFoundError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json('{"messages":[{"content":"Hello","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-99"}')
        await client.chat(req)
    except NotFoundError as error:
        print(f"NotFoundError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
